description: The portfolio's configuration, extended by name rather than copied: sborka's `default.json` (the Monday batch, the kotlin / kotlinx / sborka / ci-actions groups, the stack held until Kotlin 2.5.20, majors to a human). The harness preset is second because package rules are concatenated in the order the presets are named; its precondition holds here — both jobs of check.yaml run on `pull_request`.

One rule of this repository's own: the two kits are offered at any time, not on Monday. The board exists to be the kits' first consumer before Maven Central (research D4), so every build a kit's `main` publishes to reposilite has to reach the board the day it is published, not at the end of the week (B-05).

packageRules.description: The kits, from reposilite's snapshots: every published build, the same day, one pull request per kit. The registry is named here because Renovate cannot see it otherwise: sborka's settings plugin declares the snapshot repository at build time, and without this line Renovate looks the kits up on Maven Central and reports `no-result` (B-05's positive control, Dependency Dashboard #9).
